note: Working reproduction of the acceptance check "freshness rebuild --layer lexical --from-clean, run twice, expect identical lexical layer digest". govbridge.core.freshness.run() restricts execution to exactly the named layer for the WHOLE call (never invoking any other registered builder), so the literal single-process CLI form cannot populate real content by itself -- see the sibling LITERAL-transcript file for the direct KeyError proof, and BR-AR-0004.report.yaml open_issues for the full explanation. This file instead runs freshness.run(from_clean=True) twice, in separate processes, against the REAL canonical view, after importing govbridge.lexical so both the core and lexical builders are registered together -- i.e. exactly the sequence node I1 (which imports every layer package before dispatching) will use -- and compares the resulting layers.lexical block.
